claims.location: experimental design and exact RAW mapping
claims.value: Six Q Exactive HF acquisitions pairing PHA-L lectin pull-down and streptavidin-sepharose control in COS-7, HC11, and MCF-7 cells.
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol, complete deposited file inventory, and accession-linked primary record; 6 of 6 RAW basenames covered exactly once.

limitations: Each cell-line/affinity-enrichment combination has one deposited acquisition, so biological replication cannot be assessed from this deposit.
Search precursor and fragment tolerances are not stated in the accession-scoped record and are intentionally omitted.

Chloroacetamide is stated in the protocol, but no permissible PRIDE/MS accession was found for the alkylation-reagent column; the evidence-backed fixed carbamidomethyl modification is retained instead.
